title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1971-12-31
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/48k) > Adobe Audition CC2015 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy early‑70s show with standout performances of The Other One, Same Thing and Big River
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the concert’s confidence, creativity and playful vibe, highlighting a monster The Other One, an inspired take on Same Thing and surprising Jerry lead vocals on Big River. The soundboard source is praised implicitly (no complaints and even mentions of clear backing vocals), making it a highly listenable document for any Dead fan.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star, describing an exceptional performance and noting no recording issues; limited to two reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No negative comments about sound; reviewers note that backing vocals (Donna Jean) are audible, suggesting a clear and well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with confidence and playfulness, mixing tight group dynamics with exploratory jams that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Lead vocals on the second verse of Big River are highlighted as shocking (positive) and his vocal presence is noted.
